      "change_kind": "doctrine-edit",
      "target_wiki": "plugins/coordinator-claude/coordinator/docs/wiki/agent-dispatch-economics.md",
      "title": "Mechanical-disjoint multi-file work is not a self-execute carve-out",
      "body": "When work is mechanical (same edit shape across N files) AND disjoint (no cross-file coupling), the right shape is a Sonnet fan-out — even when the loci are loaded in EM context and typing feels faster. The wiki's 'Sonnet burns ~¼ the Opus tokens' line governs; loci-loaded is necessary but not sufficient for the self-execute carve-out. Real carve-out criteria are tight cross-file coherence on a SMALL surface (≤3 files per agent-dispatch-economics.md), heavy reasoning that doesn't decompose, or a mid-edit hazard — not 'mechanical and parallel.' The failure mode is the EM rationalizing the carve-out because typing feels faster than dispatching; same loop fires twice in the same session if the rule isn't internalized. Symmetric failure mode: applying review/integrator findings manually instead of dispatching review-integrator — 'after every review, dispatch the review-integrator — do not integrate manually' (coordinator CLAUDE.md § Review Sequencing). Both are the same shape — EM convincing itself it's cheaper inline.",
      "scope_tags": [
        "em-self-execute",
        "fan-out",
        "review-integration",
        "token-economics"
      ],
      "evidence": "session 2026-06-15 e69d3099 (snippet-sync-consumer-registry execute-plan) — recurred twice in one session: (1) attempted manual integration of the Staff Engineer substrate-adjudication into plan body (7 Edit calls) instead of dispatching review-integrator — PM correction landed; (2) self-executed 7 disjoint snippet-body backlink Edits inline instead of dispatching Sonnet fan-out — PM correction landed. Both rationalized via 'loci loaded, mechanical, fast.'",
      "liveness": "LIVE"
    }
  }
